PROJECT.opportunity_name: The 6:12 AM Quiet Ritual - holiday ceramic mug (Holiday Commerce Pilot)

WHAT_RESEARCH_FOUND.summary: Execute a low-cost holiday commerce pilot validating consumer interest for a quiet morning ritual ceramic concept across owned storefront and print-on-demand/marketplace channels without paid advertising exposure or inventory risk.
questions: Does organic content produce landing-page clicks?
Which hook earns the most engagement per reach?
What is the real Printify COGS + ship time for a comparable mug?

MARKETING_PLAN.positioning: The counter-holiday gift: a calm, substantial ceramic mug for the quiet minutes before the house wakes.
hooks: The only fifteen minutes of the holidays that belong entirely to you.
Zero snowflakes. Zero Santas. Just a quiet ceramic mug for slow winter mornings.
A gift for the person who is always up before everyone else.

spend.recommended: $0 now; consider $20 boost test on best hook after 7 days of organic data
